title: Can Islamic branding and religiosity enhance the financial performance of halal MSMEs? An explanatory study
core_idea: Assess how Islamic branding, religiosity, Islamic financial literacy, and entrepreneurial mindset affect the financial performance of halal MSMEs using a quantitative explanatory approach with a validated questionnaire and SEM-PLS analysis on a sample of 224 halal MSMEs in Malang city and regency.
tldr: This study investigates the causal relationships between Islamic branding, religiosity, Islamic financial literacy, and entrepreneurship orientation on the financial performance of halal MSMEs using survey data from 224 firms in Malang and SEM-PLS analysis.
